caseno: Appeal from Appellate Decree No. 451 of 1965.
lawyer:
Md. Yasin ------ For the Appellant. 
Syed Moinul Haque ----- For the Respondents.
parties:
Dr. Jamiar Rahman Asia Bibi  ------ Appellant.
Vs.
Tajuddin Sikder and ors  ------ Respondents.
full_judgment: 6. Mr. Md. Yasin, the learned Advocate appearing for the appellants, has submitted that the Court of appeal below misread the defendant's documents, specially Ext. A, B, C, and D and thus failed to consider that they were sufficient evidence as to hostile possession and ouster of the plaintiff. Ext. A is a copy of registered kabuliyot executed by one Maher Ali in 1924 in favour of Amir Akon. Mr. Yasin has pointed out the plaintiff admitted in cross examination that Maher Ali had a kolkorshi in respect of some land of C. S. Khatian No.15 and the plaintiff never got any rent from Maher Ali or his son Mosharraf (P.W.3). He has urged that Ext. A shows that Amir Akon claimed the properties left by his father to himself and treated the same accordingly. Ext. B is a registered mortgage executed by Amir Akon in respect of the entire karsha land of C.S. khatian No. 15 and other lands in favour of the landlords. Mr. Yasin has pointed out that the statement in para 6 of the written statement, that after the death of Garib Hossain his share in the karsha developed on Amir Akon and the same was recorded in the name of Moksed in Ext. 6, S. A. Khatian No.104, was neither challenged nor denied. Mr. Yasin has further contended that the appellate Court did not consider that the dakhilas Ext. D, were produced from the custody of the defendant.
